backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the healthcare backend, defining data types (UserProfile, MLPrediction, Credentials, etc.) and implementing CRUD operations for user profiles, credentials, and ML predictions with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Documents deployment fixes applied to resolve frontend build failures, including replacing Node.js `process.env` with Vite `import.meta.env`, removing duplicate provider wrappers, and consolidating provider composition in App.tsx.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite frontend app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in the full provider tree (ThemeProvider, DesignBProvider, QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider), and renders the DesignBAppShell layout.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: localStorage-based demo account store providing createAccount and verifyCredentials functions with phone-number uniqueness enforcement and simple password hashing for non-production use.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the demo credential store, including DemoAccount, VerifyCredentialsResult, and CreateAccountResult interfaces.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Local session management utility using localStorage to save, load, validate, and clear sessions for OTP, password, and guest authentication flows with a 30-day expiry.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Core logic module that processes user input by detecting emergencies, greetings, navigation intents, and medical/specialty queries, then returns a structured CommandResult with an appropriate response.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Renders the assistant chat panel including a welcome/empty state with capability badges and suggested prompts, message transcript list, and a typing indicator, auto-scrolling to the latest message.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence of the assistant transcript at schema version 3, including migration from v1/v2, and exposes load, save, and clear functions.
Defines all shared TypeScript types and interfaces for the assistant feature, including AssistantMessage, CommandResult, SpecialtyFilter, and related enums.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Floating assistant widget with a slide-in sheet UI that handles user text/voice input, specialty selection, message state, and delegates to assistantBrain for responses and navigation.
frontend/src/components/assistant/genera: Defines a static knowledge base of general health and science topics (immune system, vaccines, inflammation, etc.) with keyword arrays and detailed markdown-formatted responses for each topic.
frontend/src/components/assistant/langua: Provides client-side language detection for 23 supported languages using Unicode character range checks and word/pattern matching, returning a detected language code, BCP-47 locale, and confidence level.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Contains a large static array of medical topics (cardiology, dermatology, etc.) each with keyword triggers and structured markdown responses covering diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and when to seek care.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Messag: Parses and renders markdown-like assistant message content (headings, lists, tables, blockquotes, bold, inline code) into styled React elements.
frontend/src/components/assistant/messag: Implements a deterministic text summarizer that extracts symptoms, findings, recommendations, and warnings from long assistant responses into concise bullet-point summaries while preserving medical terminology and emergency indicators.
frontend/src/components/assistant/multil: Defines localized UI string templates (greeting, help text, error messages, etc.) for eight supported languages used by the health and general AI assistant.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, generating interpretations for common lab values, suggesting actions, and identifying red flags without using any AI/LLM.
Extracts plain text from uploaded file bytes by checking for text-based file extensions/content types and validating the decoded UTF-8 output is not binary garbage.
frontend/src/components/assistant/respon: Formats medical and general assistant responses with empathetic openings, specialty attribution headers, urgency indicators, and a standard medical disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/assistant/specia: Defines a static knowledge base of medical specialties (e.g., cardiology, dermatology) with keywords, conditions, symptoms, diagnostic tools, treatments, red flags, and formatted educational content.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Sugges: Small clickable chip button component that displays a suggested prompt with an optional emoji icon and fires an onClick callback with the prompt text.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Typing: Displays an animated three-dot bouncing typing indicator alongside the assistant avatar to signal a pending response.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook that manages the assistant conversation transcript, persisting messages to storage and exposing methods to add messages, toggle expansion, and clear the transcript.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useCus: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: React hook wrapping the Web Speech API to provide speech-to-text with interim results, confidence level classification, retry logic on errors, and typed error handling.
React hook wrapping the Web Speech Synthesis API to enable togglable text-to-speech with speaking state tracking and cancel support.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: Custom React hook that manages auto-scrolling behavior for a transcript container, tracking whether the user is near the bottom and automatically scrolling when new transcript entries are added.
frontend/src/components/CloseButton.tsx: Reusable close button component that navigates to /home by default or calls an optional onClick handler, rendered as a fixed ghost icon button in the top-right corner.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: A reusable dashboard section header component that renders a title, optional caption, and an optional action element aligned to the right.
A configurable dashboard tile component with an icon, label, value, and caption, supporting multiple color accents, sizes, variants, active/close states, and optional click interaction.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: A simple surface wrapper component that applies card background styling with three variants: default, elevated (with shadow), and outlined (with border).
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Exports four typed typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) with consistent Tailwind-based text styling.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: A toggle switch component that allows users to switch between the default and Design B themes using the DesignB theme context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Exports a mock user profile object generated with a fixed seed using a faker utility, used as demo/placeholder data.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: The main app shell layout for Design B, including a sticky header with branding and user info, bottom navigation, a voice assistant widget, and a footer.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: A fixed bottom navigation bar with tabs for Home, Reports, and Profile, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Provides utility functions to save and load the selected design theme ('default' or 'designB') from localStorage.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines the Design B theme constants (palette, fonts, spacing, radius) and exports functions to apply or remove the theme via a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: React context provider and hook for managing the active design theme, persisting changes to localStorage and syncing the theme to a DOM data attribute.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the user's Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: A hook that exposes methods for managing local authentication sessions, supporting OTP, password, and guest sign-in flows via session storage utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendCredentials: A hook that wraps backend credential operations (check, add, verify) using React Query mutations and queries against the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: A hook that simulates OTP generation and verification with expiry and resend cooldown logic, intended for demo/phone-based authentication flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status. Wraps DFINITY's AuthClient with a provider component and custom configuration loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Custom hook for managing medical file operations (list, upload, delete, download) against the backend canister using React Query. Converts backend metadata formats and handles file blob operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend data fetching, including a placeholder example query and a hook to fetch the current user's profile via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Hook that redirects already-authenticated users to /home, checking both Internet Identity and local session validity. Intended for use on public pages like sign-in.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin by checking both Internet Identity and local session state.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Hook that resolves a display name for the current user using a priority chain: profile full name, session name/phone, guest label, or shortened Internet Identity principal.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for light, dark, and Design B themes including color tokens for UI components.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using a seeded PRNG to produce realistic demo user profiles including names, emails, phone numbers, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` helper that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for an appointment details page component.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Full-featured chat page with a medical AI assistant supporting text input, speech recognition, specialty filtering, suggested prompts, and per-message specialty badges.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Health dashboard home page displaying today's metrics (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and quick-action tiles for navigating to chatbot, reports, and other health tools.
frontend/src/pages/Medications.tsx: Medications page that displays a daily medication schedule with taken/untaken status and reminder times, requiring authentication.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Redirects any unmatched or removed routes (e.g., /locate) to /home on mount and renders nothing.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page that loads and displays personal/medical information, supports editing via a dialog with validation, and provides a sign-out action.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical reports page that allows authenticated users to upload, view, and delete medical documents with file size formatting and upload status feedback.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page supporting OTP (phone-based), password, and Internet Identity authentication flows, with navigation to home on success and guest access option.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Sign-up page that collects full name, phone, and password to create a new account, stores credentials in the backend, and initializes a local profile session.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing/welcome page displaying the app logo, hero image, and CTA buttons to navigate to sign-in or continue as a guest.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Provides bidirectional mapping functions between the backend UserProfile type and the frontend ProfileDetails type, including blood type enum conversion and bigint date handling.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Manages localStorage persistence of ProfileDetails keyed by the current session (phone number or guest ID), with functions to load, save, clear, and initialize profile data from auth.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the ProfileDetails interface for frontend profile data and provides utility functions to create an empty profile and check whether a profile has any saved values.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates ProfileDetails fields (name, email, phone, emergency contact) and returns a list of human-readable error messages along with an isValid flag.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React hook that fetches and saves user profile details, routing to either the ICP backend (Internet Identity) or localStorage depending on the active session type.
Utility module for persisting medical file metadata in localStorage, providing load, save, delete, and clear operations; noted as deprecated for listing in favor of the backend API.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Reads build-time environment variables via Vite's import.meta.env to expose the Internet Identity provider URL and overall frontend configuration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting and clearing those values via sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom color tokens using OKLCH variables, typography/container-query/animate plugins, and extended theme values like fonts, shadows, and keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the app as a health assistant, tracking a pending Firebase integration feature request that has been rejected as an unsupported platform.
